starting.card: Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince

description: This deck has it all: power, battling, capturing, drains, and space. Helped me win a tourney a few weeks ago.
cards: Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince
posted: Agents of the Black Sun/VOTDP
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting': Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince, Coruscant, Coruscant: Imperial City, Prince Xizor ('Price Xixor'), Imperial Arrest Order, Secret Plans, All Wrapped Up and Prepared Defenses; they count toward the 60. With several starting Effects, no single starting Effect is set. Secret Plans is the 2001 Effect.

Posted 'CC Fett' dested Boba Fett (Cloud City); 'Bossk w/Gun' Bossk With Mortar Gun; 'Iggy w/Gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Zuckuss in Ship' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Iggy in Ship' IG-88 In IG-2000; 'Tatooine DB' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 and the Tatooine sites the Dark site pages; 'JP Dungeon' Jabba's Palace: Dungeon; 'Monnok x2' the plain A New Hope Monnok as posted.

The strategy's 'To Review' section lists later changes (two Hidden Weapons out for another Xizor and Jodo Kast; 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle, Bossk In Hound's Tooth, Boba Fett In Slave I and Hutt Bounty in; Scum And Villainy, a Stinger and a Virago out), not applied to the list.
The description says the deck 'Helped me win a tourney a few weeks ago' (unnamed). Total 60 as published.
